task.solution: Pose 1: det J = l1 l2 sin q2 = 0, so J has rank 1 and both columns are perpendicular to link 1; the velocity component along link 1 is lost. hints: Expand J11 J22 - J12 J21 symbolically; the terms in q1 + q2 cancel, leaving a compact expression in one joint angle.
Evaluate that expression's sign for each pose (use the sign of the sine of the relevant angle, noting where it equals exactly zero). Do not use the other angles.
det J = l1 l2 sin q2 depends on q2 alone. Pose 1: sin q2 = -0.8912, so det J < 0. Pose 2: sin q2 = 0, so det J = 0. Pose 3: sin q2 = 0.7174, so det J > 0. Pose 4: sin q2 = -0.5155, so det J < 0.
